name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues

    (hlo : f.criticalValue i ≤ r)

    f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i

name: TDA.Filtration.exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber
    (F : X → ι → β)
    (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i))
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber F) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ orderChamber F ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i j,
        (F x₀ i ≤ F x₀ j ↔ F x i ≤ F x j)

name: TDA.Filtration.isOpen_orderChamber
statement:
theorem isOpen_orderChamber [Finite ι] (F : X → ι → β) :

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (F : X → FilterFunction K β)
    (hF : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x => (F x).value s))
    {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s))
    (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (F x), d.enum = e.enum

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
    [Finite (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (F : X → FilterFunction K β)
    (hF : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x => (F x).value s))
    {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s)) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x)

    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ finiteWeight η t s - finiteWeight η t r ∧
      finiteWeight η t s - finiteWeight η t r ≤ (s - r) / 2

statement: @[simp] theorem weight_some (η t r : ℝ) : weight η (some t) r = finiteWeight η t r

statement: @[simp] theorem closedActive_none (r : ℝ) : ClosedActive none r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_active
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_domination
statement:
theorem deletionMap_domination (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : V) :
    dist x (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr x) ≤
      weight η (deletionTime seed η x) r -
        weight η (deletionTime seed η (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr x)) r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_of_active
statement:
@[simp] theorem deletionMap_of_active (seed : V) {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    {x : V} (hx : OpenActive (deletionTime seed η x) r) :
    deletionMap seed η r hη hr x = x

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_nonneg
statement:
theorem deletionTime_nonneg (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    (x : V) : ∀ t ∈ deletionTime seed η x, 0 ≤ t

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_of_ne
statement:
theorem deletionTime_of_ne (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ seed) :
    deletionTime seed η x = some
      (radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem deletionTime_seed (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : deletionTime seed η seed = none

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.netPoint_active_weight_zero
statement:
theorem netPoint_active_weight_zero (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : V) :
    let q := netPoint seed (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr) x
    OpenActive (deletionTime seed η q) r ∧ weight η (deletionTime seed η q) r = 0

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.openActive_none
statement: @[simp] theorem openActive_none (r : ℝ) : OpenActive none r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.iterated_cover
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.iterated_cover {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ)
    (p : V) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : Finset V, C.card ≤ Λ ^ h ∧
      ∀ x, dist p x ≤ R → ∃ q ∈ C, dist q x ≤ R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.of_isometry_real
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.of_isometry_real (f : V → ℝ) (hf : Isometry f) :
    ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) 4

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.packing_bound
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.packing_bound {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ)
    (p : V) {R δ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (h : ℕ)
    (hratio : 2 * (R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) < δ) (P : Finset V)
    (hball : ∀ x ∈ P, dist p x ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ P, ∀ y ∈ P, x ≠ y → δ ≤ dist x y) :
    P.card ≤ Λ ^ h

TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex
statement:
theorem closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    closedActiveComplex seed η r ≤ sparseComplex seed η r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteSparseFiltration_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteSparseFiltration_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty V] (η : ℝ) :
    finiteSparseFiltration (V := V) η = ⊥

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_closedActiveComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_closedActiveComplex (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η r ↔
      s ∈ relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r ∧
        ∀ x ∈ s, ClosedActive (deletionTime seed η x) r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_relaxedComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_relaxedComplex (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ relaxedComplex η time r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ 0 ≤ r ∧
      ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, relaxedDistance η time r x y ≤ r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sparseComplex (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ sparseComplex seed η r ↔ ∃ a, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r ∧ s ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η a

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedComplex_le_rips
statement:
theorem relaxedComplex_le_rips {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (time : V → Option ℝ) :
    relaxedComplex η time r ≤ (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedComplex_mono
statement:
theorem relaxedComplex_mono {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time : V → Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t) :
    Monotone (relaxedComplex η time)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedDistance_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem relaxedDistance_self (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (r : ℝ) (x : V) :
    relaxedDistance η time r x x = 2 * weight η (time x) r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.rips_le_relaxedComplex
statement:
theorem rips_le_relaxedComplex {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (time : V → Option ℝ) :
    (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel ((1 - 2 * η) * r) ≤ relaxedComplex η time r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.singleton_seed_mem_sparse
statement:
theorem singleton_seed_mem_sparse (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ({seed} : Finset V) ∈ sparseFiltration seed η r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_eq_bot_of_neg
statement:
theorem sparseComplex_eq_bot_of_neg (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 0) :
    sparseComplex seed η r = ⊥

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_mono
statement: theorem sparseComplex_mono (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : Monotone (sparseComplex seed η)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_finiteWeight
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteWeight {η t : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_relaxedDistance
statement:
theorem continuous_relaxedDistance {V : Type*} [MetricSpace V] {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2) (time : V → Option ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t) (x y : V) :
    Continuous (relaxedDistance η time · x y)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_weight
statement:
theorem continuous_weight {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time : Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ t ∈ time, 0 ≤ t) :
    Continuous (weight η time)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_eq_max_min
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_eq_max_min {η t : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (r : ℝ) :
    finiteWeight η t r = max 0 (min ((r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2) (η * r))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.dist_le_pairEntry
statement:
theorem dist_le_pairEntry (x y : V) :
    dist x y ≤ pairEntry (η := η) time x y

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_bddBelow
statement:
theorem pairEntrySet_bddBelow (x y : V) :
    BddBelow (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_closed
statement: theorem pairEntrySet_closed (x y : V) : IsClosed (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_mono
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_nonempty
statement:
theorem pairEntrySet_nonempty (x y : V) :
    (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y).Nonempty

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_le_iff
statement:
theorem pairEntry_le_iff (x y : V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    pairEntry (η := η) time x y ≤ r ↔ relaxedDistance η time r x y ≤ r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_le_of_mem
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_mem
statement:
theorem pairEntry_mem (x y : V) :
    pairEntry (η := η) time x y ∈ pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_nonneg
statement: theorem pairEntry_nonneg (x y : V) : 0 ≤ pairEntry (η := η) time x y

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.exists_assigned_vertex
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.exists_packing_depth
statement:
theorem exists_packing_depth {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) :
    ∃ h : ℕ, 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.facesOfDimension_card_le
statement:
theorem facesOfDimension_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (j : ℕ) :
    (facesOfDimension seed η j).card ≤ Fintype.card V * (Λ ^ h) ^ j

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbor_closedActive_at_time
TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbor_dist_le
statement:
theorem laterNeighbor_dist_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (p : V)
    (hp : p ≠ seed) {q : V} (hq : q ∈ laterNeighbors seed η p) :
    dist p q ≤ radius seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_card_le
statement:
theorem laterNeighbors_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (p : V) :
    (laterNeighbors seed η p).card ≤ Λ ^ h

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem laterNeighbors_seed (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : laterNeighbors seed η seed = ∅

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_subset_prefix
statement:
theorem laterNeighbors_subset_prefix (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p : V) :
    laterNeighbors seed η p ⊆ greedyPrefix seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_laterNeighbors
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_laterNeighbors (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p q : V) :
    q ∈ laterNeighbors seed η p ↔ insertionIndex seed q < insertionIndex seed p ∧
      ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_orientedEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_orientedEdges (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p q : V) :
    (p, q) ∈ orientedEdges seed η ↔ insertionIndex seed q < insertionIndex seed p ∧
      ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseCarrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sparseCarrier (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔ ∃ a, 0 ≤ a ∧ σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η a

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseCarrier_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sparseCarrier_iff (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔ ∃ r, σ ∈ sparseFiltration seed η r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.orientedEdges_card_le
statement:
theorem orientedEdges_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) :
    (orientedEdges seed η).card ≤ Fintype.card V * Λ ^ h

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pair_mem_carrier_iff_oriented
statement:
theorem pair_mem_carrier_iff_oriented (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {p q : V} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔
      (p, q) ∈ orientedEdges seed η ∨ (q, p) ∈ orientedEdges seed η

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.skeletonFaces_card_le
statement:
theorem skeletonFaces_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (m : ℕ) :
    (skeletonFaces seed η m).card ≤ Fintype.card V * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (Λ ^ h) ^ j

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.bifiltration_apply
statement:
theorem bifiltration_apply [Fintype V] (d : MetricSpace V) (p : Index) :
    bifiltration d p = subdivision (openRips d (radius p)) (mass p)

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.bifiltration_le_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem bifiltration_le_of_dist_le [Fintype V] (d e : MetricSpace V) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hde : ∀ v w, e.dist v w ≤ d.dist v w + 2 * δ)
    {p q : Index} (hk : mass q ≤ mass p) (hr : radius p + δ ≤ radius q) :
    bifiltration d p ≤ bifiltration e q

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.distanceCoordinates_dist
statement:
theorem distanceCoordinates_dist [Fintype V] (d : MetricSpace V) (v w : V) :
    dist (distanceCoordinates d v) (distanceCoordinates d w) = d.dist v w

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.index_le_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem index_le_iff (p q : Index) :
    p ≤ q ↔ mass q ≤ mass p ∧ radius p ≤ radius q

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.isometry_distanceCoordinates
TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mass_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem mass_pos (p : Index) : 0 < mass p

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_bifiltration_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_bifiltration_relabel_iff [Fintype V] [Fintype W] (e : V ≃ W)
    (d : MetricSpace V) (f : MetricSpace W)
    (h : ∀ v w, f.dist (e v) (e w) = d.dist v w)
    (p : Index) (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S.map (relabelVertex e) ∈ bifiltration f p ↔ S ∈ bifiltration d p

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openCech_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openCech_iff {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (p : V → X)
    (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openCech p r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ x, ∀ v ∈ s, dist x (p v) < r

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_iff (d : MetricSpace V) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openRips d r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧
      ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, d.dist v w < 2 * r

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_iff_diameter_lt
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_iff_diameter_lt (d : MetricSpace V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openRips d r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ Rips.diameter d s < 2 * r

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_relabel_iff (e : V ≃ W) (d : MetricSpace V) (f : MetricSpace W)
    (h : ∀ v w, f.dist (e v) (e w) = d.dist v w) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s.map e.toEmbedding ∈ openRips f r ↔ s ∈ openRips d r

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_iff
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_iff [Fintype V] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (k : ℝ) (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S ∈ subdivision K k ↔ S.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ K ∧ k ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ⊆ t ∨ t ⊆ s

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_iff_of_least
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_iff_of_least [Fintype V] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (k : ℝ) (S : Finset (Finset V)) {s₀ : Finset V} (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ S)
    (hleast : ∀ s ∈ S, s₀ ⊆ s) :
    S ∈ subdivision K k ↔
      (∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ K) ∧ k ≤ (s₀.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V ∧
      ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ⊆ t ∨ t ⊆ s

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_relabel_iff [Fintype V] [Fintype W] (e : V ≃ W)
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W)
    (hKL : ∀ s, s.map e.toEmbedding ∈ L ↔ s ∈ K) (k : ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S.map (relabelVertex e) ∈ subdivision L k ↔ S ∈ subdivision K k

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.openCech_eq_openRips
statement:
theorem openCech_eq_openRips {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.openRips_mono
statement:
theorem openRips_mono (d : MetricSpace V) {r q : ℝ} (h : r ≤ q) :

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.radius_pos

TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_one_eq_singleton

theorem subdivision_one_eq_singleton [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_openCech_eq
statement:
theorem subdivision_openCech_eq {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] [Fintype V]

    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (a : Index) :

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_app_apply
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_app_apply {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (c : (componentFunctor f).obj U) :
    (componentNatTrans h comm).app U c = componentMap (preimageRestrict h comm U) c

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentNatTrans_app_mk {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (x : {x : X // f x ∈ U}) :
    (componentNatTrans h comm).app U (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨h x.1, by rw [comm]; exact x.2⟩ : {z : Z // g z ∈ U})

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_comp
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_comp {W : Type u} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)}
    {e : C(W, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W))
    (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z) (hkh : ∀ x, e ((k.comp h) x) = f x) :
    componentNatTrans (k.comp h) hkh = componentNatTrans h hh ≫ componentNatTrans k hk

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_comp_app_mk
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_comp_app_mk {W : Type u} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)}
    {g : C(Z, Y)} {e : C(W, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W))
    (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (x : {x : X // f x ∈ U}) :
    (componentNatTrans k hk).app U ((componentNatTrans h hh).app U (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨k (h x.1), by rw [hk, hh]; exact x.2⟩ : {w : W // e w ∈ U})

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_id
statement:

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_naturality
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_naturality {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (componentFunctor f).map i ≫ (componentNatTrans h comm).app V =
      (componentNatTrans h comm).app U ≫ (componentFunctor g).map i

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_naturality_mk
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_naturality_mk {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (i : U ⟶ V)
    (x : {x : X // f x ∈ U}) :
    (componentFunctor g).map i ((componentNatTrans h comm).app U (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)) =
      (componentNatTrans h comm).app V ((componentFunctor f).map i (ZerothHomotopy.mk x))

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_proof_irrel

name: TDA.Mapper.TowerExamples.three_stage_tower_composite_and_collapsing_edge
statement:
theorem three_stage_tower_composite_and_collapsing_edge :
    threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap first_le_last =
        VertexMap.comp
          (threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap first_le_middle)
          (threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap middle_le_last) ∧
      threeStageComponentIndex .first false ≠
        threeStageComponentIndex .first true ∧
      ({threeStageComponentIndex .first false,
          threeStageComponentIndex .first true} :
          Finset (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (threeStageCover .first))) ∈
        threeStageTower.mapperComplex threeStageMap .first ∧
      (({threeStageComponentIndex .first false,
          threeStageComponentIndex .first true} :
          Finset (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (threeStageCover .first))).image
          (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap
            (threeStageRefinement first_le_middle))) =
        {threeStageComponentIndex .middle ()}

theorem mem_of_le_of_le {I : OpenInterval} {x y z : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ I) (hz : z ∈ I) (hxy : x ≤ y)
    (hyz : y ≤ z) : y ∈ I

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.EdgeActive.exists_mem
TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.EdgeActive.mono
statement:
theorem EdgeActive.mono (hIJ : I ≤ J) {e : G.edgeSet} (he : EdgeActive G h I e) :

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.coe_dartEdge
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) = d.edge

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.continuous_dartHeight
statement: theorem continuous_dartHeight (d : G.Dart) : Continuous (dartHeight h d)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartEdge_eq_iff
statement:
theorem dartEdge_eq_iff {d₁ d₂ : G.Dart} :
    dartEdge d₁ = dartEdge d₂ ↔ d₁ = d₂ ∨ d₁ = d₂.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartEdge_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem dartEdge_symm (d : G.Dart) : dartEdge d.symm = dartEdge d

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_injective
statement:
theorem dartHeight_injective {d : G.Dart} (hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd) :
    Function.Injective (dartHeight h d)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_of_eq
statement:
theorem dartHeight_of_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : h d.fst = h d.snd) (t : unitInterval) :
    dartHeight h d t = h d.fst

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_one
statement: @[simp] theorem dartHeight_one (d : G.Dart) : dartHeight h d 1 = h d.snd

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_symm
statement:
theorem dartHeight_symm (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    dartHeight h d.symm (σ t) = dartHeight h d t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem dartHeight_zero (d : G.Dart) : dartHeight h d 0 = h d.fst

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔
      ∃ t : unitInterval, 0 < (t : ℝ) ∧ (t : ℝ) < 1 ∧ dartHeight h d t ∈ I

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔ Nonempty {t : unitInterval // dartHeight h d t ∈ I}

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_of_eq
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_of_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : h d.fst = h d.snd) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔ h d.fst ∈ I

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_of_mem
statement:
theorem edgeActive_of_mem {e : G.edgeSet} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) (hI : h v ∈ I) :
    EdgeActive G h I e

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_dartEdge_eq
statement: theorem exists_dartEdge_eq (e : G.edgeSet) : ∃ d : G.Dart, dartEdge d = e

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_dartEdge_eq_fst
statement:
theorem exists_dartEdge_eq_fst {e : G.edgeSet} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, dartEdge d = e ∧ d.fst = v

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_interior_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_interior_of_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    ∃ s : unitInterval, 0 < (s : ℝ) ∧ (s : ℝ) < 1 ∧ dartHeight h d s ∈ I

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.fst_mem_dartEdge
statement: theorem fst_mem_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : d.fst ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.mem_dartEdge
statement:
theorem mem_dartEdge {d : G.Dart} {v : V} :
    v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) ↔ v = d.fst ∨ v = d.snd

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.ordConnected_preimage_lineHeight
statement:
theorem ordConnected_preimage_lineHeight (d : G.Dart) {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s.OrdConnected) :
    ((fun r : ℝ => (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd) ⁻¹' s).OrdConnected

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_add_const
statement:
theorem plHeight_add_const (c : ℝ) :
    plHeight G (fun v => h v + c) = plHeight G h + ContinuousMap.const (Realization G) c

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_add_const_apply
statement:
theorem plHeight_add_const_apply (c : ℝ) (x : Realization G) :
    plHeight G (fun v => h v + c) x = plHeight G h x + c

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem plHeight_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) = dartHeight h d t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds
statement:
theorem plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds (d : G.Dart) (s t r : unitInterval) :
    min (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s)) (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t)) ≤
        plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ∧
      plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ≤
        max (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s)) (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_unique
statement:
theorem plHeight_unique (g : C(Realization G, ℝ)) (hv : ∀ v, g (vertex G v) = h v)
    (he : ∀ d t, g (edgePoint G d t) = dartHeight h d t) : g = plHeight G h

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_vertex
statement: @[simp] theorem plHeight_vertex (v : V) : plHeight G h (vertex G v) = h v

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.snd_mem_dartEdge
statement: theorem snd_mem_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : d.snd ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V)

name: TDA.Mapper.Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover
statement:
theorem Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Set.Ioo a (a + n * (r - g) + g) ⊆ ⋃ k : Fin n, (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)

name: TDA.Mapper.coe_uniformInterval
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_uniformInterval (a r g : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (uniformInterval a r g k : Set ℝ) = Ioo (a + k * (r - g)) (a + k * (r - g) + r)

name: TDA.Mapper.coverMultiplicityAtMost_uniformCover
TDA.Mapper.exists_uniformCover_window
statement:
theorem exists_uniformCover_window {r g : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g < r) (a M : ℝ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ M < a + n * (r - g) + g

name: TDA.Mapper.iUnion_uniformCover
statement:
theorem iUnion_uniformCover {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ⋃ k : Fin n, (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ) = Set.Ioo a (a + n * (r - g) + g)

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_uniformInterval
statement:
theorem mem_uniformInterval {a r g y : ℝ} {k : ℕ} :
    y ∈ uniformInterval a r g k ↔ a + k * (r - g) < y ∧ y < a + k * (r - g) + r

name: TDA.Mapper.plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall
statement:
theorem plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ} {m M : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (p : Realization G) : plHeight G h p ∈ Set.Icc m M

name: TDA.Mapper.range_plHeight_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem range_plHeight_subset_Icc {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ} {m M : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) : Set.range (plHeight G h) ⊆ Set.Icc m M

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniformCover_apply (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    uniformCover a r g n k = uniformInterval a r g k

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_card_le_two
statement:
theorem uniformCover_card_le_two {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 2 * g ≤ r) :
    ∀ y (t : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ uniformCover a r g n k) → t.card ≤ 2

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_card_le_two_iff
statement:
theorem uniformCover_card_le_two_iff {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hgr : g < r) :
    (∀ y (t : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ uniformCover a r g n k) → t.card ≤ 2) ↔
      2 * g ≤ r

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_covers_range
statement:
theorem uniformCover_covers_range {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ}
    {a r g m M : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (ha : a < m)
    (hM : M < a + n * (r - g) + g) (hg : 0 < g) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Covers (fun k => (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight G h))

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_disjoint
TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_inf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem uniformInterval_inf_eq_bot {a r g : ℝ} (hg : 2 * g ≤ r) {k l : ℕ}
    (hkl : k + 2 ≤ l) : uniformInterval a r g k ⊓ uniformInterval a r g l = ⊥

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_inf_succ
statement:
theorem uniformInterval_inf_succ {a r g : ℝ} (hgr : g ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    uniformInterval a r g k ⊓ uniformInterval a r g (k + 1) =
      ioo (a + (k + 1) * (r - g)) (a + (k + 1) * (r - g) + g)

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem Diagram.ext {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {D E : Diagram α}
    (h : D.points = E.points) : D = E

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_count_essential
statement:
theorem orderedQ_count_essential {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) (b : α) :
    (orderedQ m n z).points.count (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => z.2 j = b)).card

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_count_finite
statement:
theorem orderedQ_count_finite {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) (b d : α) :
    (orderedQ m n z).points.count (b, (d : WithTop α)) =
      if b = d then 0 else
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => z.1 i = (b, d))).card

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_isPositive_iff
statement:
theorem orderedQ_isPositive_iff {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    (orderedQ m n z).IsPositive ↔ ∀ i, (z.1 i).1 ≤ (z.1 i).2

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_perm
statement:
theorem orderedQ_perm {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : Fin m → α × α) (y : Fin n → α) :
    orderedQ m n (x ∘ σ, y ∘ τ) = orderedQ m n (x, y)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_orderedQ
statement:
theorem essentialPart_orderedQ {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    essentialPart (orderedQ m n z).points =
      Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_orderedQ
statement:
theorem finitePart_orderedQ {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    finitePart (orderedQ m n z).points =
      (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_append
statement:
theorem orderedQ_append {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n m' n' : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α))
    (w : (Fin m' → α × α) × (Fin n' → α)) :
    (orderedQ (m + m') (n + n')
      (Fin.append z.1 w.1, Fin.append z.2 w.2)).points =
      (orderedQ m n z).points + (orderedQ m' n' w).points

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_eq_iff
statement:
theorem orderedQ_eq_iff {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n m' n' : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α))
    (w : (Fin m' → α × α) × (Fin n' → α)) :
    orderedQ m n z = orderedQ m' n' w ↔
      (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) =
        (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn w.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) ∧
      Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2) =
        Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn w.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_surjective
statement:
theorem orderedQ_surjective {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (D : Diagram α) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ) (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)),
      orderedQ m n z = D

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_zeroLength
statement:
theorem orderedQ_zeroLength {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → α × α) (y : Fin n → α)
    (k : Fin (m + 1)) (hk : (x k).1 = (x k).2) :
    orderedQ m n (Fin.removeNth k x, y) =
      orderedQ (m + 1) n (x, y)

name: TDA.Persistence.parts_reconstruct
statement:
theorem parts_reconstruct {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    (finitePart s).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
      (essentialPart s).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))) = s

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_relabel
statement:
theorem cost_relabel {F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (u : F₁' ≃ F₁) (v : F₂' ≃ F₂)
    (s : E₁' ≃ E₁) (t : E₂' ≃ E₂)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v s t).cost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t) =
      M.cost x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {M N : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂}
    (hf : M.finite = N.finite) (he : M.essential = N.essential) : M = N

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_presentation
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_presentation (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (hx : (Finset.univ : Finset F₁).val.map x = finitePart D.points)
    (hy : (Finset.univ : Finset F₂).val.map y = finitePart E.points)
    (hb : (Finset.univ : Finset E₁).val.map b = essentialPart D.points)
    (hc : (Finset.univ : Finset E₂).val.map c = essentialPart E.points) :
    bottleneck D E = presentationBottleneck x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_top_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D E = ⊤ ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card ≠ (essentialPart E.points).card

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_finite_only_empty
statement:
theorem bottleneck_finite_only_empty (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = 0) :
    bottleneck D (orderedQ 0 0
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ))) =
        (Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).sup
          (fun p => diagonalCost p.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_le_matching
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_matching (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) :
    bottleneck D E ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_lt_top_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_lt_top_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D E < ⊤ ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card = (essentialPart E.points).card

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_optimal_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_optimal_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    (∃ M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences,
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) =
        bottleneck D E) ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card = (essentialPart E.points).card

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_orderedQ_eq_of_eq
TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm
statement:
theorem bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm (m n : ℕ)
    (z w : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    bottleneck (orderedQ m n z) (orderedQ m n w) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖z - w‖

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_le_max
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_le_max (b d a : ℝ) :
    |d - b| / 2 ≤ max |b - a| |d - a|

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_midpoint
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_midpoint (b d : ℝ) :
    |d - b| / 2 = max |b - (b + d) / 2| |d - (b + d) / 2|

name: TDA.Persistence.fintypeOccurrenceEquiv_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem fintypeOccurrenceEquiv_value {A B : Type*}
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (f : A → B) (a : A) :
    ((fintypeOccurrenceEquiv f a : ((Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map f)) : B) = f a

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top
statement:
theorem occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) : M.cost x y b c < ⊤

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff
TDA.Persistence.orderedOccurrenceMatching_cost_le
statement:
theorem orderedOccurrenceMatching_cost_le (m n : ℕ)
    (z w : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (orderedOccurrenceMatching m n z w).cost
      (fun i => z.1 i.1) (fun i => w.1 i.1) z.2 w.2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖z - w‖

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_essential_occurrences
statement:
theorem orderedQ_essential_occurrences (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map z.2 =
      essentialPart (orderedQ m n z).points

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_finite_occurrences
statement:
theorem orderedQ_finite_occurrences (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (NonDiagonalIndices m z.1)).val.map
      (fun i => z.1 i.1) = finitePart (orderedQ m n z).points

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_constant_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_constant_empty {F : Type*}
    [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : F => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_eq_of_multiset_eq
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_eq_of_multiset_eq
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (x' : F₁' → ℝ × ℝ) (y' : F₂' → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b' : E₁' → ℝ) (c' : E₂' → ℝ)
    (hx : (Finset.univ : Finset F₁).val.map x =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F₁').val.map x')
    (hy : (Finset.univ : Finset F₂).val.map y =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F₂').val.map y')
    (hb : (Finset.univ : Finset E₁).val.map b =
      (Finset.univ : Finset E₁').val.map b')
    (hc : (Finset.univ : Finset E₂).val.map c =
      (Finset.univ : Finset E₂').val.map c') :
    presentationBottleneck x' y' b' c' = presentationBottleneck x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons (b c : ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => b) (fun _ : Fin 1 => c) = essentialPairCost b c

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_finite_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_finite_empty {F : Type*}
    [Fintype F] (x : F → ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F).sup (fun i => diagonalCost (x i))

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_le_cost
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_le_cost {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) :
    presentationBottleneck x y b c ≤ M.cost x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_lt_top_iff
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_lt_top_iff {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x y b c < ⊤ ↔
      Fintype.card E₁ = Fintype.card E₂

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    (∃ M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂,
      M.cost x y b c = presentationBottleneck x y b c) ↔
      Fintype.card E₁ = Fintype.card E₂

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_relabel
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_relabel {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (u : F₁' ≃ F₁) (v : F₂' ≃ F₂)
    (s : E₁' ≃ E₁) (t : E₂' ≃ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t) =
      presentationBottleneck x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Fin 1 => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_two_equal_vs_one
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_two_equal_vs_one (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Fin 2 => p) (fun _ : Fin 1 => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.norm_featureSum_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_featureSum_sub_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (L : ℝ) (_hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hpair : ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < p.2 → q.1 < q.2 →
      ‖F p - F q‖ ≤ L * ‖p - q‖)
    (hdiag : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < p.2 → ‖F p‖ ≤ L * (diagonalCost p).toReal)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖finiteFeatureSum F x - finiteFeatureSum F y‖ ≤ L * M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_matched
statement:
theorem sum_matched {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (g : J → E) :
    (∑ i, match M.finite i with | some j => g j | none => 0) =
      ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then g j else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_sub_eq_residual_sub_unmatched
statement:
theorem sum_sub_eq_residual_sub_unmatched {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (f : I → E) (g : J → E) :
    (∑ i, f i) - ∑ j, g j =
      (∑ i, (f i - (match M.finite i with | some j => g j | none => 0))) -
        ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else g j

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_nonneg (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.birthPersistence_snd_pos
statement:
theorem birthPersistence_snd_pos {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    0 < (birthPersistence p).2

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalCost_toReal (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (diagonalCost p).toReal = |p.2 - p.1| / 2

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFeatureSum_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFeatureSum_empty {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [IsEmpty I]
    [AddCommMonoid E] (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFeatureSum F x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFeatureSum_reindex
statement:
theorem finiteFeatureSum_reindex {I J E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [AddCommMonoid E] (e : I ≃ J) (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFeatureSum F (y ∘ e) = finiteFeatureSum F y

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePairCost_toReal (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (finitePairCost p q).toReal = ‖p - q‖

name: TDA.Persistence.norm_birthPersistence_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_birthPersistence_sub_le (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖birthPersistence p - birthPersistence q‖ ≤ 2 * ‖p - q‖

name: TDA.Persistence.integerIdentityTransition_map
statement:
theorem integerIdentityTransition_map :
    structureMap (identityTransitionDiagram ℤ)
      (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) = 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.integerZeroTransition_map
statement:
theorem integerZeroTransition_map :
    structureMapLinear integerZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.integerZeroTransition_nonidentity
statement:
theorem integerZeroTransition_nonidentity :
    structureMapLinear integerZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) ≠ LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_app {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,w} R P} (α : M ⟶ N) (q : Q) :
    (reindexNatTrans u α).app q = α.app (u q)

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_comp {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q]
    (u : Q →o P) {M N L : PModule.{u,v,w} R P} (α : M ⟶ N) (β : N ⟶ L) :
    reindexNatTrans u (α ≫ β) = reindexNatTrans u α ≫ reindexNatTrans u β

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_id {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindexNatTrans u (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (reindex u M)

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_comp
statement:
theorem reindex_comp {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] {S : Type y} [Preorder S]
    (u : Q →o P) (v : S →o Q) (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindex v (reindex u M) = reindex (u.comp v) M

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_id
statement:
theorem reindex_id (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindex (OrderHom.id : P →o P) M = M

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindex_obj {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) (q : Q) :
    (reindex u M).obj q = M.obj (u q)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_comp
statement:
theorem structureMapLinear_comp (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p q r : P}
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r) :
    structureMapLinear M (hpq.trans hqr) =
      (structureMapLinear M hqr).comp (structureMapLinear M hpq)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMapLinear_reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {q₁ q₂ : Q} (h : q₁ ≤ q₂) :
    structureMapLinear (reindex u M) h = structureMapLinear M (u.monotone' h)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMapLinear_self (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p : P} (h : p ≤ p) :
    structureMapLinear M h = LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMap_comp
TDA.Persistence.structureMap_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {q₁ q₂ : Q} (h : q₁ ≤ q₂) :
    structureMap (reindex u M) h = structureMap M (u.monotone' h)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMap_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_self (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p : P} (h : p ≤ p) :
    structureMap M h = 𝟙 (M.obj p)

name: TDA.Persistence.zmodTwoZeroTransition_map
statement:
theorem zmodTwoZeroTransition_map :
    structureMapLinear zmodTwoZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.zmodTwoZeroTransition_nonidentity
statement:
theorem zmodTwoZeroTransition_nonidentity :
    structureMapLinear zmodTwoZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) ≠ LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_critical
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellIndex_critical (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    cellIndex c (c i) = i.succ

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem cellIndex_empty (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) : cellIndex c t = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_succ_iff
statement:
theorem cellIndex_eq_succ_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex c t = i.succ ↔ c i ≤ t ∧ ∀ j, i < j → t < c j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cellIndex_eq_zero_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex c t = 0 ↔ ∀ i, t < c i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem cellIndex_of_adjacent (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) (t : ℝ) (hlo : c i ≤ t) (hhi : t < c j) :
    cellIndex c t = i.succ

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_of_last_le
statement:
theorem cellIndex_of_last_le (c : Fin (n + 1) ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h : c (Fin.last n) ≤ t) : cellIndex c t = Fin.last (n + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isConstructible_empty_iff
statement:
theorem isConstructible_empty_iff (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    IsConstructible c M ↔ ∀ t, IsZero (M.obj t)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isConstructible_reindex
statement:
theorem isConstructible_reindex (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (A : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin (n + 1))) (hA : IsZero (A.obj 0)) :
    IsConstructible c (reindex (cellIndex c) A)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isIso_toOriginal_app
statement:
theorem isIso_toOriginal_app (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (t : ℝ) : IsIso ((toOriginal c M).app t)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.lt_cellIndex_iff
statement:
theorem lt_cellIndex_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    i.val < (cellIndex c t).val ↔ c i ≤ t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_hom (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom = toOriginal c M

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom_inv_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_hom_inv_id (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv = 𝟙 _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem reconstructionIso_hom_naturality (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap (reindex (cellIndex c) (sample c M)) h ≫
      (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom.app t =
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom.app s ≫ structureMap M h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_inv_hom_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_inv_hom_id (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom = 𝟙 M

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem reconstructionIso_inv_naturality (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap M h ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv.app t =
      (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv.app s ≫
        structureMap (reindex (cellIndex c) (sample c M)) h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_obj_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_obj_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) : (sample c M).obj i.succ = M.obj (c i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_obj_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_obj_zero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (sample c M).obj 0 = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_structureMap_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_structureMap_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (sample c M) (Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr h) =
      structureMap M (c.monotone h)

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalMap_finrank_range
statement:
theorem intervalMap_finrank_range {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (I : FiniteInterval N) {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j)
    [decAlive : Decidable (I.alive i ∧ I.alive j)] :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := k) I hij)) =
      if I.alive i ∧ I.alive j then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.interval_alive_endpoints_iff
statement:
theorem interval_alive_endpoints_iff {N : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval N)
    {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (I.alive i ∧ I.alive j) ↔ I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_at_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem barcodeRankInteger_at_size {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B i (N : ℤ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_injective
statement:
theorem barcodeRankInteger_injective {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {B C : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)}
    (h : ∀ i j : ℤ, barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B i j =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) C i j) : B = C

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_nat
statement:
theorem barcodeRankInteger_nat {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j < N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ) =
      (B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i ∧ j < I.death) : ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_neg_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem barcodeRankInteger_neg_one {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (j : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyBarcode_rank_N0
statement:
@[simp] theorem emptyBarcode_rank_N0 {k : Type u} [Field k] (i j : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) (N := 0) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)) i j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks
statement:
theorem equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    (∀ i : Fin 2,
      Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj i) =
        Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj i)) ∧
      structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by omega) = 1 ∧
      structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by omega) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.fullInterval_boundary_difference
statement:
theorem fullInterval_boundary_difference {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    let B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N) := {I}
    (barcodeMultiplicity B 0 N : ℤ) =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) (N : ℤ) +
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) (N : ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.fullInterval_boundary_rank_sum_one
statement:
theorem fullInterval_boundary_rank_sum_one {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    let B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N) := {I}
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) (N : ℤ) +
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) (N : ℤ) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.multiplicity_eq_rank_difference
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_rank_difference {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (barcodeMultiplicity B b d : ℤ) =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) ((d : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) ((d : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) +
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_barcodeMap
statement:
theorem rank_barcodeMap {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j hij =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_duplicate_fullInterval_N1
statement:
theorem rank_duplicate_fullInterval_N1 {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let I : FiniteInterval 1 := ⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k)
      (({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1)) + {I})) (0 : Fin 1) 0 (by omega) = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_emptyBarcode
statement:
theorem rank_emptyBarcode {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))
      i j hij = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_fullObservedInterval
statement:
theorem rank_fullObservedInterval {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))
      ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩ (by
        apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
        change (0 : ℕ) ≤ N - 1
        omega) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_single_fullInterval_N1
statement:
theorem rank_single_fullInterval_N1 {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let I : FiniteInterval 1 := ⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1)))
      (0 : Fin 1) 0 (by omega) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_countP_grades
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_countP_grades (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ v i ∧ (v j : WithTop α) < p.2) =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_count_essential
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_count_essential (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.count (v b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      barcodeMultiplicity B b.val N

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_count_finite
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_count_finite (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.count (v b, (v d : WithTop α)) =
      barcodeMultiplicity B b.val d.val

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_injective
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_injective (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v) :
    Function.Injective (ofIndexBars v hv)

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_isPositive
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_isPositive (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).IsPositive

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_nonneg
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_nonneg (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    0 ≤ moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_at_size
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_at_size (i : ℤ) :
    moduleRankInteger M i (N : ℤ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_fin
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_fin (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    moduleRankInteger M (i.val : ℤ) (j.val : ℤ) =
      (structureMapRank M i j hij : ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_neg_one
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_neg_one (j : ℤ) :
    moduleRankInteger M (-1) j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_drop
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_drop (a c d : Fin N)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    structureMapRank M a c hac =
      structureMapRank M a d (hac.trans hcd) +
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
          ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp
            (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)).subtype))

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_four_le
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_four_le (a b c d : Fin N)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    structureMapRank M a c (hab.trans hbc) + structureMapRank M b d (hbc.trans hcd) ≤
      structureMapRank M b c hbc + structureMapRank M a d ((hab.trans hbc).trans hcd)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_mono_source
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_mono_source (a b c : Fin N)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    structureMapRank M a c (hab.trans hbc) ≤ structureMapRank M b c hbc

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle
    (a b c d : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hcd : c ≤ d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc a b, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc c d,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y) =
      moduleRankInteger M (b : ℤ) (c : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M ((a : ℤ) - 1) (c : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) +
      moduleRankInteger M ((a : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (structureMapRank M i j hij : ℤ) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (i.val + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc j.val N,
        moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (b d : ℕ)
    (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) b d : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_barcodeModule
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_barcodeModule (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) :
    rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) = B

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_eq_iff
    (L : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (L.obj i)] :
    rankBarcode M = rankBarcode L ↔
      ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
        structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank L i j hij

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_rankBarcode (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode M)) i j hij =
      structureMapRank M i j hij

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong
statement:
theorem alive_restrictAlong (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (I : FiniteInterval L)
    (J : FiniteInterval N) (h : I.restrictAlong s = some J) (j : Fin N) :
    J.alive j ↔ I.alive (s j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.restrictAlong_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem restrictAlong_eq_none_iff (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (I : FiniteInterval L) :
    I.restrictAlong s = none ↔ ∀ j : Fin N, ¬ I.alive (s j)

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode_reindex
statement:
theorem barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (reindex s M)) b d =
      let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
      let B := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      let C := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      let D := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
        barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) x y

name: TDA.Persistence.lt_sampledEndpoint_iff
statement:
theorem lt_sampledEndpoint_iff (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (e : ℕ) (j : Fin N) :
    j.val < sampledEndpoint s e ↔ (s j).val < e

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
      let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
      let B := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      let C := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      let D := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
        moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_reindex
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L) :

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_reindex

theorem structureMapRank_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)

    structureMapRank (reindex s M) i j hij =
      structureMapRank M (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.alive_endpoints_dropZero
statement:
theorem alive_endpoints_dropZero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (t : ℝ) :

statement:
theorem endpoints_dropZero_essential (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (hd : I.death = n + 1) :
    (endpoints c (dropZero I hb)).2 = ⊤

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.endpoints_dropZero_finite
statement:
theorem endpoints_dropZero_finite (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (hd : I.death ≤ n) :
    (endpoints c (dropZero I hb)).2 =
      (c ⟨I.death - 1, by have := I.birth_lt_death; omega⟩ : WithTop ℝ)

statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_points (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) :

statement:

statement:
theorem restrictAlong_succ (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) :

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.sampledEndpoint_succ

    DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.familyIso_hom_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem familyIso_hom_lof (F G : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (e : ∀ i, F i ≅ G i) (t : ℝ) (i : ι) (z : (F i).obj t) :
    (((familyIso F G e).hom).app t).hom
      (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i z) =
      DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (G j).obj t) i (((e i).hom.app t).hom z)

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.sigmaIso_hom_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaIso_hom_lof {κ : ι → Type}
    (F : (Σ i, κ i) → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ i) (z : (F ⟨i,j⟩).obj t) :
    (((sigmaIso F).hom).app t).hom
      (DirectSum.lof k (Σ i, κ i) (fun a => (F a).obj t) ⟨i,j⟩ z) =
    DirectSum.lof k ι (fun a => DirectSum (κ a) (fun b => (F ⟨a,b⟩).obj t)) i
      (DirectSum.lof k (κ i) (fun b => (F ⟨i,b⟩).obj t) j z)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalBoundaryCost_nonneg (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ c i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) :

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_relabel
statement:
theorem totalBoundaryCost_relabel (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J)

    (c : I → J → ℝ) (uCost : I → ℝ) (vCost : J → ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalBoundaryCost (fun i j => c (u i) (v j)) (uCost ∘ u) (vCost ∘ v) =
      M.totalBoundaryCost c uCost vCost

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_compose_le
statement:
theorem cost_compose_le (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (N : OccurrenceMatching F₂ F₃ E₂ E₃)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (z : F₃ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (d : E₃ → ℝ) :
    (M.compose N).cost x z b d ≤ M.cost x y b c + N.cost y z c d

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_of
statement:
theorem cost_le_of (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (r : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hs : ∀ i, (match M.finite i with
      | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
      | none => diagonalCost (x i)) ≤ r)
    (ht : ∀ j, (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j)) ≤ r)
    (he : ∀ k, essentialPairCost (b k) (c (M.essential k)) ≤ r) :
    M.cost x y b c ≤ r

statement:

    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :

    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (k : E₁) :

statement:

statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_boundary_point (x : Interior) :
    dist Space.boundary (.point x) = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_collapse_boundary
statement:
theorem dist_collapse_boundary (x : ClosedHalfPlane) :
    dist (collapse x) Space.boundary = (x.1.2 - x.1.1) / 2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_point_boundary
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_point_boundary (x : Interior) :
    dist (.point x) (Space.boundary) = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_point_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_point_point (x y : Interior) :
    dist (Space.point x) (Space.point y) = min (dist x y) (depth x + depth y)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_point_dist_boundary_lt
statement:
theorem exists_point_dist_boundary_lt {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x : Interior, 0 < dist (Space.point x) Space.boundary ∧
      dist (Space.point x) Space.boundary < ε

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.far_points_shortcut
statement:
theorem far_points_shortcut :
    dist (Space.point ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩)
      (Space.point ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩) = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.far_points_squared_shortcut_and_boundary_legs
statement:
theorem far_points_squared_shortcut_and_boundary_legs :
    dist (Space.point ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩)
        (Space.point ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩) ^ 2 = 4 ∧
      depth ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩ ^ 2 + depth ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩ ^ 2 = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.isOpenEmbedding_point
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_point : IsOpenEmbedding Space.point

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.lipschitz_collapse
statement: theorem lipschitz_collapse : LipschitzWith 1 collapse

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.lipschitz_point
statement: theorem lipschitz_point : LipschitzWith 1 Space.point

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableEmbedding_point
statement: theorem measurableEmbedding_point : MeasurableEmbedding Space.point

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_iff_interior
statement:
theorem measurableSet_iff_interior (s : Set Space) :
    MeasurableSet s ↔ MeasurableSet (Space.point ⁻¹' s)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapse
statement: theorem measurable_collapse : Measurable collapse

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_boundary_boundary
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_boundary_boundary : rho .boundary .boundary = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_boundary_point
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_boundary_point (x : Interior) : rho .boundary (.point x) = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_comm
statement: theorem rho_comm (x y : Space) : rho x y = rho y x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem rho_eq_zero_iff (x y : Space) : rho x y = 0 ↔ x = y

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_point_boundary
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_point_boundary (x : Interior) : rho (.point x) .boundary = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_point_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem rho_point_point (x y : Interior) :
    rho (.point x) (.point y) =
      min (finitePairCost x.1 y.1).toReal (depth x + depth y)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_self
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_self (x : Space) : rho x x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_triangle
statement: theorem rho_triangle (x y z : Space) : rho x z ≤ rho x y + rho y z

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryPlan_mass_lt_top
TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_diagonalPlan
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_diagonalPlan (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ≤
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν < ∞

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.continuous_interiorIncl
statement: theorem continuous_interiorIncl : Continuous interiorIncl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.deleteLeg_distance
statement:
theorem deleteLeg_distance (x : Interior) :
    dist (interiorIncl x) (diagonalProjection x) = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν) μ ν

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν =
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) +
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν) < ∞

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_mass
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_mass (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν Set.univ = μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_finite_cost_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_finite_cost_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) < ∞

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.insertLeg_distance
statement:
theorem insertLeg_distance (x : Interior) :
    dist (diagonalProjection x) (interiorIncl x) = depth x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.interiorIncl_injective
statement: theorem interiorIncl_injective : Function.Injective interiorIncl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableEmbedding_interiorIncl
statement: theorem measurableEmbedding_interiorIncl : MeasurableEmbedding interiorIncl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_secondFiber

theorem measurableSet_secondFiber {s : Set Interior} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :

statement: theorem measurable_deleteLeg : Measurable deleteLeg

statement: theorem measurable_insertLeg : Measurable insertLeg

theorem planSpace_iff_not_both_diagonal (z : ClosedHalfPlane × ClosedHalfPlane) :

      ¬ (z.1.1.1 = z.1.1.2 ∧ z.2.1.1 = z.2.1.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_lt_top
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_lt_top (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior)

    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν < ∞

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_self
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_self (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_symm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_symm (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan
TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_self
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_self (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (μ : Measure Interior) :

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_symm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_symm (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν = boundaryTransportPowerValue p ν μ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.identityBoundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem identityBoundaryPlan_admissible (μ : Measure Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (identityBoundaryPlan μ) μ μ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.identityBoundaryPlan_cost
statement:
theorem identityBoundaryPlan_cost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (μ : Measure Interior) :
    ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂identityBoundaryPlan μ = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_identityLeg
statement: theorem measurable_identityLeg : Measurable identityLeg

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_transposePlan
statement: theorem measurable_transposePlan : Measurable transposePlan

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planPowerCost_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem planPowerCost_transpose (p : ℝ) (z : PlanSpace) :

TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_cost

theorem transposePlan_cost (p : ℝ) (π : Measure PlanSpace) :
