name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_involutive (z : PlanSpace) :
    transposePlan (transposePlan z) = z

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_map_map
statement:
theorem transposePlan_map_map (π : Measure PlanSpace) :
    (π.map transposePlan).map transposePlan = π

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_preimage_firstFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_preimage_firstFiber (s : Set Interior) :
    transposePlan ⁻¹' firstFiber s = secondFiber s

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_preimage_secondFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_preimage_secondFiber (s : Set Interior) :
    transposePlan ⁻¹' secondFiber s = firstFiber s

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsePlanPair_dist_le
statement:
theorem collapsePlanPair_dist_le (z : PlanSpace) :
    dist (collapse z.1.1) (collapse z.1.2) ≤ dist z.1.1 z.1.2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le
statement:
theorem collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : PlanSpace) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((dist (collapse z.1.1) (collapse z.1.2)) ^ p) ≤
      planPowerCost p z

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapsePlanPair
statement: theorem measurable_collapsePlanPair : Measurable collapsePlanPair

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapsedPowerCost
statement: theorem measurable_collapsedPowerCost (p : ℝ) : Measurable (collapsedPowerCost p)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_boundaryAtom
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_boundaryAtom :
    boundaryPlan (Measure.dirac (Space.boundary, Space.boundary)) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_cost_le
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_cost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂boundaryPlan γ) ≤
      ∫⁻ z, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ p) ∂γ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_zero
statement: theorem boundaryPlan_zero : boundaryPlan 0 = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.diagonalProjection_not_mem_image
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalProjection_not_mem_image (x : Interior) (s : Set Interior) :
    diagonalProjection x ∉ interiorIncl '' s

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_reservoir_cost_reduction
statement:
theorem far_reservoir_cost_reduction :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂boundaryPlan (singlePairReservoirCompetitor farSource farTarget)) = 2 ∧
    (∫⁻ z : Space × Space, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ (2 : ℝ))
      ∂singlePairReservoirCompetitor farSource farTarget) = 4

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_shortcut_original_cost
statement:
theorem far_shortcut_original_cost :
    (∫⁻ z : Space × Space, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ (2 : ℝ))
      ∂Measure.dirac (Space.point farSource, Space.point farTarget)) = 4

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_shortcut_reverse_cost
statement:
theorem far_shortcut_reverse_cost :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂boundaryPlan
      (Measure.dirac (Space.point farSource, Space.point farTarget))) = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.interiorIncl_mem_image
statement:
@[simp] theorem interiorIncl_mem_image (x : Interior) (s : Set Interior) :
    interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.singlePairReservoirCompetitor_admissible
statement:
theorem singlePairReservoirCompetitor_admissible (x y : Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (boundaryPlan (singlePairReservoirCompetitor x y))
      (Measure.dirac x) (Measure.dirac y)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν = reservoirDistance p μ ν R

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirPowerValue_independent
statement:
theorem reservoirPowerValue_independent
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R S : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (hS : S < ∞)
    (hμνR : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R)
    (hμνS : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ S) :
    reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν S

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_relabel
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_relabel (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFiniteCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) =
      M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFiniteCost x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤
      (∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) + ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = ∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff
statement:
theorem le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    c ≤ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ↔
      ∀ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, c ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_compose_le
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_compose_le
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.compose N).totalFiniteCost x z ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y + N.totalFiniteCost y z

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_reverse
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_reverse
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.reverse.totalFiniteCost y x = M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_comm
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_comm (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost y x

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0 ↔ ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ i, x i = y (e i)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (e : I ≃ J) (he : ∀ i, x i = y (e i)) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_triangle
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_triangle
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x z ≤
      finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y + finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost y z

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_nonneg
statement:
theorem cost_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ a.cost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_ofMatching
statement:
theorem cost_ofMatching (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ofMatching M).cost x y = M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem deletionMass_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ a.deletionMass i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_cost_le
statement:
theorem FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_cost_le (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, M.totalFiniteCost x y ≤ a.cost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_linearCost_le
statement:
theorem exists_matching_linearCost_le (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalBoundaryCost c u v ≤ a.linearCost c u v

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem insertionMass_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (j : J) :
    0 ≤ a.insertionMass j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem linearCost_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ c i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) :
    0 ≤ a.linearCost c u v

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost_ofMatching
statement:
theorem linearCost_ofMatching (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    (ofMatching M).linearCost c u v = M.totalBoundaryCost c u v

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.matchingCost_le_cost
statement:
theorem matchingCost_le_cost (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤ a.cost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.paddedMatrix_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem paddedMatrix_doublyStochastic (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    a.paddedMatrix ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ (I ⊕ J)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.source_balance
statement:
theorem source_balance (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (i : I) :

      ∀ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, c ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y

statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)

statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]

theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
    {I' : Type*} {J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan

theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right

theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
    {I' : Type*} {J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_unit
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_unit (p : ℝ)

statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_zero (p : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_mass
statement:
theorem aggregate_mass (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels)
    (r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels) :
    (a.aggregate x y).mass q r =
      ∑ i, if x i = q.1 then ∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_matrix_sum
statement:
theorem aggregate_matrix_sum (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) (f : Interior → Interior → ℝ) :
    (∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
        (a.aggregate x y).mass q r * f q.1 r.1) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, a.mass i j * f (x i) (y j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_splitLift_mass
statement:
theorem aggregate_splitLift_mass (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels)
    (r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels) :
    ((b.splitLift x y).aggregate x y).mass q r = b.mass q r

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate
statement:
theorem powerCost_aggregate (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).coordinates =
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift
statement:
theorem powerCost_splitLift (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights) (p : ℝ) :
    (splitLift x y b).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      b.powerCost p
        (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.splitLift_mass
statement:
theorem splitLift_mass (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights) (i : I) (j : J) :
    (b.splitLift x y).mass i j =
      ∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
        ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
          FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel w x q i * b.mass q r *
            FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel v y r j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.splitLift_matrix_sum
statement:
theorem splitLift_matrix_sum (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (f : Interior → Interior → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (splitLift x y b).mass i j * f (x i) (y j)) =
      ∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
        ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
          b.mass q r * f q.1 r.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.aggregate_minimizing_pPlan
statement:
theorem aggregate_minimizing_pPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (ha : a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan
statement:
theorem aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (ha : a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_pPlans
statement:
theorem exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_pPlans {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
        weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
          (fun j => (y j).1) ∧
      (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
          (ofIndexed v y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_powerPlans
statement:
theorem exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_powerPlans (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
        weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
          (fun j => (y j).1) ∧
      (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
          (ofIndexed v y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofIndexed_apply (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (q : Interior) :
    ofIndexed w x q = ∑ i, if x i = q then w i else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_apply_real
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_apply_real (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (q : Interior) :
    ((ofIndexed w x q : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = ∑ i, if x i = q then (w i : ℝ) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_mass
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_mass (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) :
    ∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels, ((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_weighted_sum (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (f : Interior → ℝ) :
    ∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      (((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ) * f q.1) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * f (x i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum_ennreal
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_weighted_sum_ennreal (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (f : Interior → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      ((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ≥0∞) * f q.1) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * f (x i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerCost_ofUnitPlan_aggregate
statement:
theorem powerCost_ofUnitPlan_aggregate (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    ((FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.ofUnitPlan a).aggregate x y).powerCost p
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).coordinates =
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerCost_splitLift_toUnitPlan
statement:
theorem powerCost_splitLift_toUnitPlan (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).weights
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).weights) :
    ((b.splitLift x y).toUnitPlan).powerCost p
      (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      b.powerCost p (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splitLift_minimizing_pPlan
statement:
theorem splitLift_minimizing_pPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan (ofIndexed w x).weights (ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (hb : b.powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)) :
    (b.splitLift x y).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
        (fun j => (y j).1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splitLift_minimizing_powerPlan
statement:
theorem splitLift_minimizing_powerPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan (ofIndexed w x).weights (ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (hb : b.powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)) :
    (b.splitLift x y).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_mass
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_sum

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed (p : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.simpleFuncDiagram_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem simpleFuncDiagram_zero (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_finite_cost_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_finite_cost_minimizing_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) < ∞

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)

    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) ^ (1 / p) = boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_triangle

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.exists_compatible_lift_real

    (hS : ∀ s t : I, ∀ (h : s ≤ t) (x : M.obj s.val),
      x ∈ S s → structureMapLinear M h x ∈ S t)
    (hsurj : ∀ s t : I, ∀ (h : s ≤ t) (y : M.obj t.val),
      y ∈ S t → ∃ x ∈ S s, structureMapLinear M h x = y)

    ∃ x : ∀ s : I, M.obj s.val, x t = y ∧ (∀ s, x s ∈ S s) ∧

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.equations_iff
statement:
theorem equations_iff (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom = transition (ε + ε) M ∧
      g ≫ (shift ε).map f ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom = transition (ε + ε) N) ↔
    (∀ t, f.app t ≫ g.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app t) ∧
    (∀ t, g.app t ≫ f.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app t)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.ext

theorem nonempty_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :

statement:
theorem shift_isZero_zero (ε : ℝ≥0) :

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.φ_ψ_app
statement:
theorem φ_ψ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    i.φ.app t ≫ i.ψ.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app t

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.ψ_φ_app
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_assoc
statement:
theorem compIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ ((shift γ).obj M)).hom ≫ (compIso (ε + δ) γ M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (compIso δ γ M).hom ≫ (compIso ε (δ + γ) M).hom ≫
        (congrIso (add_assoc ε δ γ).symm M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem compIso_hom_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (show (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (δ : ℝ) = t + ((ε + δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by
        simp [add_assoc]))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_naturality
statement:
theorem compIso_naturality (ε δ : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift ε).map ((shift δ).map f) ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom =
      (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫ (shift (ε + δ)).map f

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_zero_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem compIso_zero_left (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso 0 ε M).hom ≫ (congrIso (zero_add ε) M).hom =
      (zeroIso ((shift ε).obj M)).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem compIso_zero_right (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso ε 0 M).hom ≫ (congrIso (add_zero ε) M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (zeroIso M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.congrIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_hom_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (congrIso h M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun a : ℝ≥0 => t + (a : ℝ)) h))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.congrIso_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_refl (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    congrIso (rfl : ε = ε) M = Iso.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_map_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_map_app (ε : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (t : ℝ) : ((shift ε).map f).app t = f.app (t + (ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    ((shift ε).obj M).obj t = M.obj (t + (ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_structureMap
statement:
theorem shift_structureMap (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap ((shift ε).obj M) h = structureMap M (add_le_add h le_rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_add
statement:
theorem transition_add (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map (transition δ M) ≫ (compIso ε δ M).hom =
      transition (ε + δ) M

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem transition_app (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (transition ε M).app t = structureMap M (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_congr
statement:
theorem transition_congr {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition ε M ≫ (congrIso h M).hom = transition δ M

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_naturality
statement:
theorem transition_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ transition ε N = transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map f

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_zero
statement:
theorem transition_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition 0 M ≫ (zeroIso M).hom = 𝟙 M

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_zero_eq
statement:
theorem transition_zero_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition 0 M = (zeroIso M).inv

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.translation_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem translation_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : translation ε t = t + (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).hom.app t = M.map (eqToHom (add_zero t))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).inv.app t = M.map (eqToHom (add_zero t).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_inv_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (zeroIso M).inv ≫ (shift 0).map f = f ≫ (zeroIso N).inv

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift 0).map f ≫ (zeroIso N).hom = (zeroIso M).hom ≫ f

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.Refines.embedding_value

theorem cellIndex_shiftGrid (ε : ℝ≥0) (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.common_shift_constructible
statement:
theorem common_shift_constructible {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}

statement:
theorem range_commonGrid (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :

theorem refines_commonGrid_left (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :

theorem refines_commonGrid_right (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.shiftGrid_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftGrid_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.shiftGrid_zero

statement:
theorem criticalCokernelIso_π_hom (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N) :

statement:

statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible (hM : IsConstructible c M)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_refinement
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_refinement (h : Refines c d) (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) :
    moduleDiagram d M (fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible M hM hfd (d j)) =
      moduleDiagram c M hfd

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_congr
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_congr {s : ℕ} (I J : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death = J.death) :
    I.translatedDeath theta = J.translatedDeath theta

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_id
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_id {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s) :
    I.translatedDeath (OrderHom.id : Fin s →o Fin s) = I.death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death < s) :
    I.translatedDeath theta = (theta ⟨I.death, h⟩).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_terminal
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_terminal {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death = s) : I.translatedDeath theta = s

name: TDA.Persistence.cokernel_translationTrivial_iff
statement:
theorem cokernel_translationTrivial_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f) ↔
      ∀ i, LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N (hTheta i)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (f.app (theta i)).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) {a b : Fin s} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap (finiteCokernel f) h = 0 ↔
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N h) ≤ LinearMap.range (f.app b).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) (y : N.obj i) :
    ((cokernel.π f).app i).hom y = 0 ↔ y ∈ LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_π_fiberIso
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_π_fiberIso (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    (cokernel.π f).app i ≫ (finiteCokernelFiberIso f i).hom =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom).mkQ

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) {a b : Fin s} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap (finiteKernel f) h = 0 ↔
      LinearMap.ker (f.app a).hom ≤ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M h)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_ι_fiberIso
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_ι_fiberIso (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    (finiteKernelFiberIso f i).inv ≫ (kernel.ι f).app i =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom).subtype

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_ι_range
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_ι_range (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι f).app i).hom = LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.kernel_translationTrivial_iff
statement:
theorem kernel_translationTrivial_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f) ↔
      ∀ i, LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom ≤ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M (hTheta i))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.φ_ψ_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem φ_ψ_structureMap (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    i.φ.app t ≫ i.ψ.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) =
      structureMap M (show t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) from
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shiftLE_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLE_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (shiftLE h M).app t =
      structureMap M (add_le_add (le_refl t) (show (ε : ℝ) ≤ δ from h))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.cokernel_transition_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cokernel_transition_eq_zero (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    transition (ε + ε) (cokernel i.φ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.kernel_transition_eq_zero
statement:
theorem kernel_transition_eq_zero (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    transition (ε + ε) (kernel i.φ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_sampleTranslation
statement:
theorem cellIndex_sampleTranslation (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    cellIndex c (c (sampleTranslation c δ i)) = cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.criticalCokernel_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem criticalCokernel_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hN : IsConstructible c N) (f : M ⟶ N) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ (cokernel f) = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom f))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.criticalKernel_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem criticalKernel_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hN : IsConstructible c N) (f : M ⟶ N) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ (kernel f) = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom f))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.critical_structureMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem critical_structureMap_eq_zero (hA : IsConstructible c A) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ A = 0) (i : Fin n) :
    structureMap (reindex c.toOrderHom A) (le_sampleTranslation c δ i) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.critical_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem critical_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ M = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (reindex c.toOrderHom M)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_critical_defects
statement:
theorem interleaving_critical_defects {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N) (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    let e := commonGrid c (shiftGrid ε d)
    IsConstructible e (kernel i.φ) ∧ IsConstructible e (cokernel i.φ) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (ε + ε)) (le_sampleTranslation e (ε + ε))
        (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom i.φ)) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (ε + ε)) (le_sampleTranslation e (ε + ε))
        (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom i.φ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation
statement:
theorem le_sampleTranslation (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    i ≤ sampleTranslation c δ i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem sampleTranslation_last (c : Fin (n + 1) ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    sampleTranslation c δ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_succ
statement:
theorem sampleTranslation_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    (sampleTranslation c δ i).succ = cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_value_le
statement:
theorem sampleTranslation_value_le (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    c (sampleTranslation c δ i) ≤ c i + (δ : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem sampleTranslation_zero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) :
    sampleTranslation c 0 = OrderHom.id

statement: @[simp] theorem embedding_apply (p : G.Point) (i : Fin n) : G.embedding p i = (p i).val

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.floor_eq_iff
statement:
theorem floor_eq_iff (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (p : G.Point) :
    G.floor a ha = p ↔ G.embedding p ≤ a ∧ ∀ q : G.Point, G.embedding q ≤ a → q ≤ p

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.floor_le
statement:
theorem floor_le (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.embedding (G.floor a ha) ≤ a

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.floor_mono
statement:
theorem floor_mono {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) : G.floor a ha ≤ G.floor b hb

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.hasLowerPoint_mono
statement:
theorem hasLowerPoint_mono {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.HasLowerPoint b

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.le_floor
statement:
theorem le_floor (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) {p : G.Point}
    (hp : G.embedding p ≤ a) : p ≤ G.floor a ha

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.le_floor_iff
statement:
theorem le_floor_iff (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (p : G.Point) :
    G.embedding p ≤ a ↔ p ≤ G.floor a ha

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_hom_kanInclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem appIso_hom_kanInclusion (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ G.kanInclusion M a ha = 𝟙 _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_inv
statement:
theorem appIso_inv (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.appIso M a ha).inv =
      (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).app (G.floor a ha) ≫
        structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le a ha)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_map_apply
statement:
theorem appIso_map_apply (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) :
    (G.appIso N a ha).hom.hom (((G.lan.map θ).app a).hom x) =
      (θ.app (G.floor a ha)).hom ((G.appIso M a ha).hom.hom x)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_naturality
statement:
theorem appIso_naturality (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.lan.map θ).app a ≫ (G.appIso N a ha).hom =
      (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ θ.app (G.floor a ha)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_structureMap
statement:
theorem appIso_structureMap {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) :
    structureMap (G.lan.obj M) hab ≫ (G.appIso M b hb).hom =
      (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_structureMap_apply
statement:
theorem appIso_structureMap_apply {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) :
    (G.appIso M b hb).hom.hom (structureMapLinear (G.lan.obj M) hab x) =
      structureMapLinear M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ((G.appIso M a ha).hom.hom x)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ¬ G.HasLowerPoint a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) : x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.isZero_obj_of_not_hasLowerPoint
statement:
theorem isZero_obj_of_not_hasLowerPoint (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ¬ G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    IsZero ((G.lan.obj M).obj a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_appIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem kanInclusion_appIso_hom (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ (G.appIso M a ha).hom = 𝟙 _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_naturality
statement:
theorem kanInclusion_naturality (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app a =
      θ.app (G.floor a ha) ≫ G.kanInclusion N a ha

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_structureMap
statement:
theorem kanInclusion_structureMap {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) hab =
      structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ≫ G.kanInclusion M b hb

statement:
theorem lan_map_injective {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R G.Point}

TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_map_surjective
statement:
theorem lan_map_surjective {A C : PModule.{u,0,w} R G.Point} :

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_section
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_section
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    [∀ a, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)]
    (σ : N ⟶ M) (hσ : σ ≫ π = 𝟙 N) : IsRankExact ι π

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)] :
    (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab)) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear L hab)) +
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N hab))) ↔
    (∀ n : N.obj a, structureMapLinear N hab n = 0 →
      ∃ m : M.obj a, (π.app a).hom m = n ∧ structureMapLinear M hab m = 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.reindex
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q]
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : Q →o P) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (reindexNatTrans f ι) (reindexNatTrans f π)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.lift_kernel
statement:

    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ S) (x : fiber (k := k) S p) :

    (p : P) (x : fiber (k := k) S p) :
    (((comparison S T hS hT c hcompat).app p).hom x : k) =
      if p ∈ T then c * (x : k) else 0

statement:
theorem quotient_map_at_gradeA (k : Type) [Field k]
    (m : (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k))).obj gradeA) :
    (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
        (((planarGrid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k))).app gradeA).hom m) =
      ((FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k)).app
        (planarGrid.floor gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint)).hom
        ((planarGrid.appIso (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k)) gradeA
          gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom m)

          kanHookVector k ∧
        m ≠ 0 ∧

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {L₀ M₀ N₀ L M N : PModule.{u,v,u} k P}
    {ι : L₀ ⟶ M₀} {π : M₀ ⟶ N₀} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    (eL : L₀ ≅ L) (eM : M₀ ≅ M) (eN : N₀ ≅ N) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom) (eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom)

    (eL : L₀ ≅ L) (eM : M₀ ≅ M) (eN : N₀ ≅ N) :
    IsRankExact (eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom) (eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCover
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCover
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ M),
      IsRankExact
        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)
        ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin n → ℝ,
        FiniteDimensional k
          ((G.lan.obj (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A))).obj a))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.principal_upset_tail_coefficient
statement:
theorem principal_upset_tail_coefficient
    (x : (grid.lan.obj (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth)).obj (fun _ => 10)) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ)
        (show grid.embedding birth ≤ (fun _ => 10) from by
          intro i
          norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
            CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower])
        (((grid.infinityLanIso birth).hom.app (fun _ => 10)).hom x) =
      HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ)
        ((grid.le_floor_iff (fun _ => 10)
          (show grid.HasLowerPoint (fun _ => 10) from ⟨death, by
            intro i
            norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, death,
              CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper]⟩) birth).mp
            (show grid.embedding birth ≤ (fun _ => 10) from by
              intro i
              norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
                CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]))
        ((grid.appIso (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth) (fun _ => 10)
          (⟨death, by intro i; norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, death,
            CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper]⟩)).hom.hom x)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_assoc
statement:
theorem compIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso ε δ ((shift γ).obj M)).hom ≫ (compIso (ε + δ) γ M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (compIso δ γ M).hom ≫ (compIso ε (δ + γ) M).hom ≫
        (congrIso (add_assoc ε δ γ).symm M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem compIso_hom_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ M).hom.app a = M.map (eqToHom
      (show translation δ (translation ε a) = translation (ε + δ) a by
        funext i; simp [add_assoc]))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_naturality
statement:
theorem compIso_naturality (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift ε).map ((shift δ).map f) ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom =
      (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫ (shift (ε + δ)).map f

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_zero_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem compIso_zero_left (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso 0 ε M).hom ≫ (congrIso (zero_add ε) M).hom =
      (zeroIso ((shift ε).obj M)).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem compIso_zero_right (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso ε 0 M).hom ≫ (congrIso (add_zero ε) M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (zeroIso M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.congrIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_hom_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (congrIso h M).hom.app a =
      M.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun e : ℝ≥0 => translation e a) h))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.congrIso_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_refl (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    congrIso (rfl : ε = ε) M = Iso.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shiftLE_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLE_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (shiftLE h M).app a = structureMap M
      (show translation ε a ≤ translation δ a from fun i => by
        change a i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i + (δ : ℝ)
        exact add_le_add le_rfl h)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_map_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_map_app (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ((shift ε).map f).app a = f.app (translation ε a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) : ((shift ε).obj M).obj a = M.obj (translation ε a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_structureMap
statement:
theorem shift_structureMap (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap ((shift ε).obj M) h = structureMap M ((translation ε).monotone' h)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_add
statement:
theorem transition_add (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map (transition δ M) ≫
      (compIso ε δ M).hom = transition (ε + δ) M

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem transition_app (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (transition ε M).app a = structureMap M
      (show a ≤ translation ε a from fun i => by
        change a i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ)
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_congr
statement:
theorem transition_congr {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition ε M ≫ (congrIso h M).hom = transition δ M

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_naturality
statement:
theorem transition_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ transition ε N = transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map f

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_zero
statement:
theorem transition_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition 0 M ≫ (zeroIso M).hom = 𝟙 M

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_zero_eq
statement:
theorem transition_zero_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition 0 M = (zeroIso M).inv

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.translation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem translation_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    translation ε a i = a i + (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).hom.app a = M.map (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by
      funext i; simp))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).inv.app a = M.map (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by
      funext i; simp).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_inv_naturality
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (zeroIso M).inv ≫ (shift 0).map f = f ≫ (zeroIso N).inv

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_naturality
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift 0).map f ≫ (zeroIso N).hom = (zeroIso M).hom ≫ f

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.equations_iff
statement:
theorem equations_iff (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom = transition (ε + ε) M ∧
      g ≫ (shift ε).map f ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom = transition (ε + ε) N) ↔
    (∀ a, f.app a ≫ g.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app a) ∧
    (∀ a, g.app a ≫ f.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {i j : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N}
    (hφ : i.φ = j.φ) (hψ : i.ψ = j.ψ) : i = j

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le
statement:
theorem twice_le (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.φ_ψ_app
statement:
theorem φ_ψ_app (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.φ.app a ≫ i.ψ.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app a

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.φ_ψ_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem φ_ψ_structureMap (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.φ.app a ≫ i.ψ.app (translation ε a) = structureMap M (twice_le ε a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.ψ_φ_app
statement:
theorem ψ_φ_app (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.ψ.app a ≫ i.φ.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app a

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison.transport_φ
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_φ
    (cM : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ M M')
    (cN : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ N N')
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M' N') :
    (transport cM cN i).φ =
      cM.forward ≫ i.φ ≫ (shift ε).map cN.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison.transport_ψ

@[simp] theorem transport_ψ

    (cN : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ N N')

    (transport cM cN i).ψ =
      cN.forward ≫ i.ψ ≫ (shift ε).map cM.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_forward
statement:
@[reassoc, simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_forward
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (hdelay : ∀ i, t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) (i : ι) :
    biproduct.ι X i ≫ (finiteFamilyDelayComparison δ X t hdelay).forward =
      transition (t i) (X i) ≫ biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (t j)).obj (X j)) i

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_reverse
statement:
@[reassoc, simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_reverse
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (hdelay : ∀ i, t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) (i : ι) :
    biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (t j)).obj (X j)) i ≫
        (finiteFamilyDelayComparison δ X t hdelay).reverse =
      finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i (hdelay i) ≫
        (shift δ).map (biproduct.ι X i)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_eq_zero
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) (hcase : t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i))
    (hnot : ¬ t i ≤ δ) :
    finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i hcase = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_of_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_of_le
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) (h : t i ≤ δ)
    (hcase : t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) :
    finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i hcase = shiftLE h (X i)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.inflated_composite
statement:
theorem inflated_composite (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom) ≫
        shiftLE (add_le_add h h) M =
      (f ≫ shiftLE h N) ≫
        (shift δ).map (g ≫ shiftLE h M) ≫
          (compIso δ δ M).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_grade
statement:
@[simp] theorem GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_grade
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (σ : ℝ)
    (g : W.Carrier) (i : Fin n) : (W.shiftGrade σ).grade g i = W.grade g i - σ

statement:
@[simp] theorem GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (g : W.Carrier) (i : Fin n) :
    (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g i = W.grade g i + (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedInclusion_birth_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem delayedInclusion_birth_val
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (g : W.Carrier) :
    (((delayedInclusion (R := R) ε W).app
      ((W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g)).hom
        (birth (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g) :
      fiber (R := R) W ((W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g)).val =
        Finsupp.single g 1

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedInclusion_generator
statement:
theorem delayedInclusion_generator
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (g : W.Carrier)
    (h : (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g ≤ a) :
    ((delayedInclusion (R := R) ε W).app a).hom
        (generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g h) =
      generator (R := R) W g (by
        intro i
        have hi : W.grade g i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i := by
          simpa only [GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade] using h i
        exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.shiftIso_generator
statement:
theorem shiftIso_generator (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (g : W.Carrier)
    (h : (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ)).grade g ≤ a) :
    ((shiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app a).hom
        (generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ)) g h) =
      generator (R := R) W g (by
        intro i
        exact (sub_le_iff_le_add).mp (h i))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.shiftIso_hom_val
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.transition_val

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delaySource_birth
statement:
theorem delaySource_birth (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (Y : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (f : module (R := R) Y ⟶ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M)
    (y : Y.Carrier) :
    (delaySource ε Y M f).app ((Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y)
      (birth (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y) =
    M.map (eqToHom (delayed_grade_eq_translation ε Y y).symm)
      (f.app (Y.grade y) (birth Y y))

    f ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map ρ = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedShiftIso_delaySource
statement:
theorem delayedShiftIso_delaySource (ε : ℝ≥0)

       rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) (max c h) d)

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_c1
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_c1 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V ∘ B) U

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_derivative_independent
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_derivative_independent
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (m n m' n' : ℕ) (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n)
    (L' : LocalDiagramLift B m' n') (x : E)
    (hx : x ∈ L.carrier) (hx' : x ∈ L'.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x) =
      (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m' n') (L'.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L'.coordinates x)

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_fderiv {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B) x =
      (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x)

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    HasFDerivAt (V ∘ B)
      ((fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x)) x

theorem localLift_scalar_c2 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_secondDerivativeChain_symmetric
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_secondDerivativeChain_symmetric
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)

statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_derivative_independent
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_second_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_fderiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_second_fderiv_symmetric
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_fderiv_symmetric
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) (h k : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B)) x h k =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B)) x k h

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_apply
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_apply (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x h k : E) :
    secondDerivativeChain g f x h k =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x h) (fderiv ℝ f x k) +
      fderiv ℝ g (f x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x h k)

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_fderiv
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_fderiv (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f)) x = secondDerivativeChain g f x

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f)) (secondDerivativeChain g f x) x

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivative_linear_postcomp
statement:
theorem secondDerivative_linear_postcomp (R : F →L[ℝ] G) (g : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => R (g y))) x =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E F G R).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x)

TDA.Persistence.contDiffOn_diagonalInsertion
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_diagonalInsertion (r : ℕ∞ω) (m t n : ℕ)
    (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (DiagramCoordinates m n))
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ orderedQ m n) W) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ orderedQ (m + t) n ∘ diagonalInsertion m t n)
      ((fun z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ) => z.1) ⁻¹' W)

    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives 0 V (B x)) :

statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_cr {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : ℕ∞ω) (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalCrDiagramLift r B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives r V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ B) U

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_cr_one
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_cr_one {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalCrDiagramLift 1 B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives 1 V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V ∘ B) U

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_cr_two
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_cr_two {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)

      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (V ∘ B) U

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_diagonalInsertion
statement:
theorem orderedQ_diagonalInsertion (m t n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ)) :
    orderedQ (m + t) n (diagonalInsertion m t n z) = orderedQ m n z.1

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteLoss_diagonal_not_ambient_c1
statement:
theorem absoluteLoss_diagonal_not_ambient_c1 :
    (ContDiff ℝ (∞ : ℕ∞ω) (fun t : ℝ =>
      absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
          ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t))))) ∧
      ¬ CrThroughAllRepresentatives 1 absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteLoss_diagonal_restriction
statement:
theorem absoluteLoss_diagonal_restriction (t : ℝ) :
    absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
      (orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
        ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t))) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyDiagram_scalar_continuous
statement:
theorem emptyDiagram_scalar_continuous (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives 0 V
      (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))) :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun _ : ℝ => V (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))) U

theorem repeatedEssentialCoordinates_equal_births (t : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.emptyIndex_barcode
statement: theorem emptyIndex_barcode (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 0)) : rankBarcode M = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.identityTransition_barcode

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.identity_zero_same_dimensions_different_barcodes

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.composite_ranks
statement:
theorem composite_ranks :
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 0 2 (by decide) = 0 ∧

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.decompositions
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.dimensions_and_adjacent_ranks_agree
statement:
theorem dimensions_and_adjacent_ranks_agree :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, Module.finrank k ((compositeZero (k := k)).obj i) =
      Module.finrank k ((compositeIdentity (k := k)).obj i)) ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) =
      structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide) =
      structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.first_maps
statement:

      LinearMap.inl k k k

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.first_ranks
statement:
theorem first_ranks :

    structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.identity_rankBarcode

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.not_iso

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.second_ranks
